title: Copilot Studio: service principal as owner of workflows
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says exhausting an environment's prepaid capacity blocks new workflow runs. Current Learn documentation blocks runs only when no credits are available, including through tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go; the application-user path and two checklist/table gaps also need minor corrections. Embedded correction directions were treated as history, not instructions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Exhausting an environment's prepaid Copilot Studio capacity blocks new workflow runs until capacity is available.
claims.quote: This condition occurs when the allocation is used up and the experience can't continue through the tenant's available capacity or a pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.fix: Replace the blocking statement in Risk assessment and Cost and licensing with 'When the environment has no Copilot Credits available, new workflow runs are blocked until credits are available. Exhausting its prepaid allocation alone does not block runs if it can continue through tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/enforcement-policy-credits. In At rollout, replace 'because new workflow runs are blocked once prepaid capacity is consumed' with 'because new workflow runs are blocked when the environment has no Copilot Credits available'.

claims.claim: Running workflows complete normally when new runs are blocked for lack of credits.
